ctx.x: Well, you're going to take this other stuff later then, huh?
Yeah, let's talk about some of the people. We were talking -- we were mentioning before King Oliver, for instance, whom you worked with --
Oh, he was fine. He was a great big man, not what you'd call fat, but big, tall and healthy looking, you know. And he had one eye. He had one eye.

items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Joe Oliver was on trumpet. ... I want to tell about Joe Oliver, how soft he would play. ... in Chicago we were slick. We'd sing really softly, like Joe Oliver and them would play.

ctx.x: On drums. Sidney Bechet was on clarinet. Joe Oliver was on trumpet. The Minor Brothers were on drums, too.
